contexts.text: Beautiful colours of their dwellings, crimson and blue. SE 3925.

Hyacinthine and crimson from the isles of Elishah () = rituals corresponding to internal worship; thus = representatives of celestial things. AC 2576:8. ( = the good of truth. AC 5954:6), ( = the intelligence of truth and good. AC 9466:3.)
Crimson, etc. () = Knowledges of good.

This veil represented the inmost appearances of rational good and truth, in which are the Angels of the Third Heaven, which appearances are described by the hyacinthine, crimson, scarlet double-dyed, and fine linen interwoven (); in which the red colour represented the goods of love, and the white its truths.
Under Red, see this reference.
If sins are red like crimson (). DP 278. a [5].
Under Colour, see these references. AC 9467. HH 179.
Hyacinthine and crimson = celestial goods and truths; scarlet double-dyed, and fine linen interwoven = spiritual goods and truths. Illustrated.
Double-dyed of crimson ().
Purple and fine linen () = the Knowledges of good and truth from the Word. AC 9467:5. HH 365:2. TCR 595:2. AE 118:4.
This good reigns in the inmost Heaven, and in the Second Heaven it presents a crimson and a hyacinthine colour; the good itself, a crimson colour...

Crimson () = the celestial love of good... The reason of this signification of crimson is that by a red colour is signified the good of celestial love. Explained, Illustrated. AC 9596. AC 9671. AC 9833.
Good from a celestial origin is also signified by crimson in ... Hyacinthine and crimson were thy covering = Knowledges of truth and good from a celestial origin.

First there is truth from a celestial origin, (fine linen); then comes the affection of truth, (hyacinthine); then the affection of good thence, (crimson); and at last spiritual good, (scarlet double-dyed).
Crimson, etc. () = the goods reigning in these Heavens.
Crimson, etc. (in the ephod, ) = the good of charity and of faith. AC 9834. AC 9839.
Crimson, etc. (in the breastplate,  5) = the good of charity and of faith.
Under Chrysoprase, see this reference.
Crimson = the good of celestial love; scarlet double-dyed, the good of spiritual love. DSS 46:end.
Those brought up upon crimson () = those who are in the Knowledges of good.
The purple in which the rich man was clothed = genuine good. ( = the good of the Word. DSS 40:3.)
(Crimson is a term which has reference to good.)
In the Heavens where love to the Lord reigns... the Angels are clad in crimson garments.
Colours derived from red, as scarlet and crimson.
Crimson for decorations.
The sailors were clad in a crimson garment.
They cried, We are doctors clad in the purple.
The woman was arrayed in crimson and scarlet () = Divine celestial good and truth of the Word with them. Crimson = Divine celestial good; scarlet, Divine celestial truth. Illustrated. AR 773.
The Angel from the east was in a resplendent crimson garment, and the one from the south in a bright hyacinthine one.
The seats in the first row were covered with crimson silk; those in the second, with blue; and those in the third with white cloth.
(Various crimson garments mentioned.) CL 20:2. CL 42:4. CL 75:4. CL 183. CL 266. TCR 595:3. TCR 673. SE 3752.

A rainbow of three colours; crimson, hyacinthine, and bright white: the crimson passed through the hyacinthine, and tinged the white with a deep blue; and this flowed back through the hyacinthine into the crimson, and raised it into a kind of flaming beam... The crimson signified the wife's marriage love, (and its being raised into a flaming beam) signified the husband's marriage love flowing back to the wife.
The rain became crimson, then scarlet...
Crimson flowers formed the outermost circle...
Love tinges her face with a kind of flame, from the shining through of which is the dawn and bloom of her life.
From the rouge she appeared beautiful. TCR 148:2.
The first gymnasium was surrounded with a crimson light...
Purple cardinals.
In its ultimate, the Word is like a transparent object... which from the flame is red like crimson, and from the light is white like snow.
Before the Angels, the good of merit appears like rust, and the good not of merit like crimson.
In Heaven they are clothed in... red, and after they have been initiated into the goods of the New Church, in... crimson.

They who have been regenerated through the Divine good of love, go in crimson garments, and are called Celestial Angels... The reason is, that crimson is the colour of love, which it derives from the sun's fire and redness.
Crimson is a red or rosy colour mingled with azure.

Nature produces such linen from a crimson flower, etc.; and it represents what is natural, which is snowy, and flows from a crimson flower, that is, from a colour which is intermediate between hyacinthine and scarlet.
Hyacinthine, or a resplendent yellow, with crimson points, = grace; crimson = mercy; it derives its redness from love, its azure from Heaven.
Universal grace is represented by a golden yellow verging to crimson; mercy and love by crimson and blood colour.
The colour of a ruby is red, and therefore = mercy in God Messiah... thus has a similar signification to the red mentioned above in crimson and scarlet double-dyed.
A flaming crimson object seen. AC 7620.
Crimson and hyacinthine () = the celestial love of good and truth.
Crimson () = the genuine good of the Word; specifically, the celestial love of truth.
As a red colour derives its origin there from what is fiery or flaming... crimson = good from a celestial origin. AE 1143. AE 1143:2.
